In response to IR-20261018-091819-903058:
Do not proceed with Option A's reduced-gate closure. Keep PR #82 unmerged. All final experiment requirements and existing stability restrictions remain in force.
Proceed with a bounded, acquisition-first version of Option B. I am willing to provide the missing ENDF/B-VIII.0 neutron evaluations for C-12 (MAT 625) and O-16 (MAT 825), including their MF4/MT2 elastic angular distributions. Provide the authoritative download location and exact destination/import procedure, or identify the minimal infrastructure change needed to overcome the download-size limit. Make the requested operator action concrete and straightforward.
After acquisition, verify identity, provenance, energy coverage and scientific suitability before substantial model construction or qualification. Obtaining the files does not establish that M3 is suitable or authorize extrapolation without scientific justification. If suitable, define and independently review the prospective construction and evaluation plan before collecting new qualification evidence.
Continue bounded autonomous investigation of the remaining discrepancy. Assess the documented proton–proton contribution and the sensitivity of the screening result to uncertainty in its archived baseline. These are investigative leads, not instructions to tune to TOPAS, substitute a favorable baseline, or repeat seeds until a test passes.
Preserve every existing failure and STOP verdict. Scientific model selection, diagnostic design and prospective revisions of internally authored plans remain autonomous responsibilities under independent review. A frozen STOP ends that candidate attempt; it does not prohibit a separately justified investigation. Preserve calibration/evaluation lineage and distinguish new findings from historical qualification results.
Defer the approximately 43.5-hour closure qualification until the investigation supports a justified next step. Use inexpensive diagnostics first, retain one heavy job at a time and complete diagnostic logging, and continue independent useful work while awaiting any data provision.
This response authorizes further investigation and preparation of the M3 acquisition route. It does not authorize removing V5/V11, waiving requirements, treating unmet requirements as satisfied, or merging before the applicable scientific, implementation, CI and independent-review gates pass.
Record this response verbatim. Keep any remaining operator request narrowly focused on the concrete external action required; return separately if you propose a material reduction in required validation scope.
